# Cygnix Labs

> Cygnix Labs builds SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) tools and fixes websites that are not showing on Google or in AI answers such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Every job follows three steps: the problem, a proof report from a real tool run, and the fix.

Contact: cygnixlabs@gmail.com · Site: https://skills.cygnixlabs.com/ · Free site check: https://skills.cygnixlabs.com/#contact

## Packages

- Monitor: $29/month. Monthly SEO + AEO audit, indexing and redirect checks, report by email.
- Growth: $59/month. Monitor plus a monthly prioritised fix plan, content decay and cannibalization checks, 2 briefs a month.
- Agency: $99/month. 5 client sites with white-label reports and all Monitor + Growth checks.
- Quick Audit: $79 one-time. Key pages of one site: indexing, meta, schema, AI readiness and a fix list.
- Full Audit: $199 one-time. Whole-site SEO + AEO audit with redirects, internal links, backlinks and content decay.
- Fix Sprint: $299 one-time. We fix the top issues from your audit, recheck and resubmit the pages to Google.
